By means of the the bail application the applicant has prayed to be enlarged on bail in Case Crime No. 398 of 2022 at Police Station- Koraon, District- Prayagraj, under Sections 363, 366, 376, 342,
IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act.
The applicant is in jail since 01.09.2022.
The bail application of the applicant was rejected by the learned trial court on 23.11.2022.

The following arguments made by Ms. Swati Agrawal Srivastava, learned counsel assisted by Ms.
Divya Yadav, learned counsel on behalf of the applicant,which could not be satisfactorily refuted by Shri Chandan Agarwal, learned AGA from the record, entitle the applicant for grant of bail:
(1).
The victim and the applicant were intimate.

sentences.text: (2). Their relationship was always consensual.
(3). The applicant never gave a plighted word to marry the victim.
(4). The criminal case is being leveraged to force the applicant to marry the victim.
(5). Learned counsel for the applicant contends that the applicant does not have any criminal history apart from the instant case.
(6). The applicant is not a flight risk.
The applicant being a law abiding citizen has always cooperated with the investigation and undertakes to cooperate with the court proceedings.
There is no possibility of his influencing witnesses, tampering with the evidence or reoffending.
In the light of the preceding discussion and without making any observations on the merits of the case, the bail application is allowed.
Let the applicant- Irfan be released on bail in the aforesaid case crime number, on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.

The following conditions be imposed in the interest of justice:-
(i) The applicant will not tamper with the evidence or influence any witness during the trial.
(ii) The applicant will appear before the trial court on the date fixed, unless personal presence is exempted.

Order Date :- 21.7.2023 Pravin  Irfan vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/197873857/
